recipes.title: Peppermint Slice
method: Melt the marg and add the dry ingredients.
425° for 20 mins. Cool a little.
For the topping, mix the icing sugar and peppermint essence with a little water and spread over.
notes: Variation (IMG_0374): 1lb icing sugar and 1 tsp peppermint essence for the topping, then spread with melted chocolate.

Variation (IMG_0367): 4oz marg, 4oz self-raising flour, 2oz brown sugar, 1 tbsp cocoa, 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda, pinch salt. Swiss roll tin, 190° for 15 mins. Topping of 12oz icing sugar, green colouring and peppermint essence mixed with hot water.

source.note: Clearest of three versions; see also IMG_0367 and IMG_0374

recipes.title: Chocolate Slice

ingredients.preparation: plus extra to line the base

method: Line the base with chocolate.
Melt the chocolate, butter and condensed milk and add the digestives.

recipes.title: Caramel Slices
method: For the base, cream the marg and caster sugar. Add the flour and baking powder.
Bake in a Swiss roll tin at 400° for 15 mins.
For the caramel, melt the marg, sugar, syrup and Nestlé's milk, then boil for 3 mins, stirring all the time.
Pour onto the base while still warm.
When cold, spread with melted chocolate.

recipes.title: Coconut Slices
method: Melt the marg and add to the mixture.
Bake in a Swiss roll tin at 300° for 20 mins.
When cool, cover with water icing.

recipes.title: Date Slices
method: Boil the dates in the water for 5 mins.
Mix the oats and flour, rub in the marg and add the sugar.
375° for 25 to 30 mins.

recipes.title: Sunshine Squares
method: Grease a 13" x 9" Swiss roll tin.
Melt the marg, sugar and syrup, then add to the crushed cornflakes and oats.
Mark 4 for 10 to 15 mins.

recipes.title: Flapjacks
method: Melt the marg, then stir in the sugar, oats, flour and salt.
Press into a 12" x 8" Swiss roll tin.
Mark 5 or 375° for 20 mins.

recipes.title: Choc Crisp Slices
method: Melt the marg and sugar in a pan. Add the dates and cook a little.
Mix in the cherries and ginger, then the crispies.
Press into a Swiss roll tin, then cover with cooking chocolate. Cut when set and cold.
checks: Ginger: mentioned in the method, no amount given.

recipes.title: Chocolate Shorties
method: Cream the butter, lard and sugar. Add the flour, cocoa and digestive biscuits.
Bake at mark 4 (350°) for about 25 mins in a Swiss roll tin.
Cut into squares and then triangles while hot.
Coat with chocolate icing.

recipes.title: Vienna Traybake
method: Cream the icing sugar and butter, then add the flour, cornflour, salt and vanilla essence.
Sprinkle with caster sugar.
Mark 4 (350°) for 20 to 25 mins.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Squares
method: For the fudge, boil the marg, sugar, condensed milk and syrup for 8 mins, then add the digestives.
checks: The rest of the base ingredients and method have faded and are unreadable.

recipes.title: Fruit Fingers
method: Melt the marg and sugar, then add the flour, fruit and egg.
Swiss roll tin, 35 mins at 160°C.

recipes.title: Chocolate Brownies
method: Melt the marg and add the egg, milk, sugar, flour, cocoa and sultanas.
180° for 15 to 20 mins.

recipes.title: Streusel Fingers
method: For the base, cream self-raising flour, sugar and marg, then add the other ingredients and milk.
Spread half in a Swiss roll tin.
For the topping, rub in the flour, butter, sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over.
350° for 35 mins.
checks: The amounts and some ingredients have faded.

recipes.title: Coconut Munchies
method: Grease an 11¼" x 7¼" baking tray.
Spread the chocolate and leave to set.
Mix the egg, caster sugar, coconut and cherries and spread over.
Mark 4 (350°) for about 20 to 30 mins.
checks: The red ink has faded towards the end.

recipes.title: Shortbread
method: Cream the marg and sugar, then add the flour and cornflour.

recipes.title: Shortbread (small batch)
method: Rub in, then knead.
350° for 30 mins (or 325° for 30 mins).

recipes.title: Shortbread Biscuits
method: Rub the butter in until it holds together.
Knead lightly.
325° for 20 to 30 mins.

recipes.title: Viennese Shortcakes
method: Cream the butter, sugar and vanilla until very soft.
Add the flour.
350° for 30 mins.

recipes.title: Ginger Shortcake
method: Cream the marg and sugar. Add the flour, baking powder and ginger.
350° for 25 to 30 mins.
For the icing, put the icing sugar, marg, ginger and syrup into a pan. Melt, but don't boil.
Spread over and cut while warm.

recipes.title: Yo-Yo Biscuits
method: Cream the marg and icing sugar.
Add the flour, custard powder and vanilla.
Bake for 20 mins at 400°.

recipes.title: Coconut Biscuits
method: Cream the marg and sugar, then add the coconut, flour and baking soda.
Make into small balls.
Do not flatten.
350° to 370° for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Coconut Biscuits (second version)
method: Cream, then roll into round balls.
325° for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Biscuits
method: Cream the butter and sugar, then add the flour and cinnamon.
Shape into a sausage and roll in granulated sugar.
Slice.
325° for 25 mins.

recipes.title: Cornflake Macaroons
method: Cream the marg and sugar.
Beat in the syrup.
Add the flour and the milk if necessary.
Bake in a moderate oven for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Crombie Nuts (Mrs Clark)
method: Cream the syrup, marg and sugar.
Add the soda dissolved in the milk, then the flour, raisins and ginger.
Flatten with a fork.
325° for 20 mins.
checks: Title: The first word of the name is unclear.

recipes.title: Queen Cakes
method: Cream the marg and sugar.
Add the eggs and flour a little at a time, alternating, then the sultanas.
Bake for 15 to 20 mins at 425°.
notes: Margin note: mark 4 for 20 mins or mark 5 for 15 mins.

recipes.title: Coconut Cakes
method: Make like queen cakes.
Ice and sprinkle with coconut.

recipes.title: Lemon or Orange Buns
method: Rub in the fat and add the sugar and rind.
Mix with the lightly beaten egg and maybe a little milk.
400° for 15 to 20 mins.

recipes.title: Rock Cakes
method: Cream the marg and sugar.
Add the egg, then the flour, mixed spice, currants and milk.
Do not overmix.
Regulo 7 to 8, 425° to 450°, for 10 to 15 mins.

recipes.title: London Buns
method: Cream the fat, sugar and egg.
Add the salt, flour, currants and milk and beat well to toughen the mixture.
Very hot oven for 8 mins.

recipes.title: Scones
method: Rub in the marg, add the sugar and mix with the milk.

recipes.title: Margaret's Pancakes
method: Dissolve the soda and cream of tartar in a little milk in a cup before adding.
